blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Modern cameras correct color via two or three pre-calibrated 3x3 matrices interpolated by Correlated Color Temperature (CCT). This collapses the illuminant SPD to a scalar. LEDs, fluorescents, and mixed sources sit off the Planckian locus, and metameric illuminants with the same chromaticity demand different optimal CCMs that a CCT pipeline cannot distinguish. We recover the illuminant SPD instead using non-negative least squares against a basis dictionary, conditioned on the camera white point and a multi-channel ambient-light sensor (ALS). A closed-form 3x3 CCM is then fit per shot. On a synthetic benchmark of 300 illuminants and 3,100 reflectances, mean angular error drops from 1.89 to 1.20 degrees, with a 1.7x tail reduction on the LED-like off-Planckian group (n=45) where metameric ambiguity is tangible. The gain holds under realistic ALS imperfections and observation noise, and the same off-Planckian advantage carries over to 1,684 real measured SPDs.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The Color Correction Matrix (CCM) is a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 linear map from white-balanced camera RGB to a colorimetric standard (CIE XYZ or sRGB). The optimal CCM depends on the scene illuminant. The standard Adobe DNG pipeline [ 1 ] stores two reference CCMs, one at T 1 = 2856 T_{1}{=}2856 K and one at T 2 = 6500 T_{2}{=}6500 K. At runtime it interpolates the two by the estimated Correlated Color Temperature (CCT). The illuminant SPD E ⁡ ( λ ) E(\lambda) — a function over wavelength — is collapsed to a single scalar.

blocks.en: This works on Planckian illuminants. Blackbody radiators are fully described by temperature, so CCT and the SPD are equivalent. Modern indoor and architectural lighting often sits off this locus. LEDs, fluorescents, and mixed sources do not follow the blackbody curve. Two sources can share x ​ y xy chromaticity to within Δ x ​ y < 0.005 \Delta_{xy}{<}0.005 yet differ in normalized SPD shape by more than 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} . Both drive the same white-point reading and the same CCT estimate. They still need different optimal CCMs. CCT-based interpolation cannot tell them apart.

blocks.en: We present a spectral-aware per-shot CCM that replaces the CCT scalar with a recovered SPD. We recover the SPD from two cheap observations: the camera’s own white-point response and a multi-channel ambient-light sensor (ALS). The ALS is a small commodity chip with 8 to 14 narrow-band photodiodes, already used in mobile phones for ambient sensing. With K + 3 K{+}3 observations against a small SPD basis, recovery is a non-negative least squares problem. The recovered SPD then synthesizes a virtual color chart, and we fit a scene-specific CCM to that chart in closed form.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个光谱感知器 每发CCM, 用一个回收的SPD取代CCTscal。 我们从两个廉价的观察中恢复SPD:相机本身的白点反应和一个多通道的环境光传感器(ALS). ALS是一种小商品芯片,有8至14个窄带光电极,已经用于移动电话进行环境感知. 有了K+3 KQQ3针对小的SPD基础的观察,恢复是一个非负方性最小的问题. 恢复的SPD然后合成一个虚拟的颜色图,我们把一个场景特定的CCM与该图以闭合的形式搭配.

blocks.en: Contributions The non-parametric NNLS form lifts CCM conditioning from chromaticity to K + 3 K{+}3 dimensions. Against six baselines on 300 EMPIR illuminants × 3,100 \times\,3{,}100 CAVE reflectances, the spectral advantage is most reliable on the LED-like off-Planckian group ( n = 45 n{=}45 ), where worst-25% error drops by 1.7 × 1.7{\times} ( 4.79 ∘ → 2.80 ∘ 4.79^{\circ}\!\to\!2.80^{\circ} ) relative to the strongest non-spectral baseline (CST-MLP 3×6 , the recent x ​ y xy -MLP of Tedla et al. [ 2 ] ); a smaller extreme subset ( n = 5 n{=}5 ) shows a larger directional gain. A channel-count ablation finds a sharp knee at K = 8 K{=}8 , matching commercially available multispectral sensors [ 3 ] . A metameric-pair stress test isolates SPD-recovery accuracy from downstream CCM behavior.

blocks.en: Related work
blocks.zh: 相关工作

blocks.en: Three lines of work bear on a spectral-aware CCM. Classical color constancy estimates an illuminant chromaticity but stops short of the CCM stage. CCT- and x ​ y xy -conditioned CCM pipelines scalarize the illuminant to one or two numbers, which a metameric pair defeats by construction. Spectral-recovery work tackles reflectance rather than the illuminant or the CCM. We position our method against each in turn.
blocks.zh: 光谱感知的CCM上有三行工作. 古典色彩恒定(Classical color constancy)估计出一种光亮的色调,但与CM阶段相比却止步不前. CCT-和xy-有条件的CCM输油管将闪光剂分解为一两个数字,一个元配对通过建造击败. 光谱恢复工作涉及反射,而不是光辉剂或集束弹药。 我们依次将我们的方法对准每个方法。

blocks.en: Classical color constancy Statistical priors — gray-world [ 4 ] , gray-edge [ 5 ] — and chromaticity-prior approaches that exploit saturated colors [ 6 ] estimate an illuminant chromaticity but stop there; downstream CCM remains a separate, illuminant-conditioned step.
blocks.zh: 古典色彩恒定统计的前身——灰色世界[4],灰色尖端[5],以及利用饱和颜色的色调先入为主的方法[6]估计出一个闪亮的色调,但止于此;下游CCM仍然是一个独立的,闪亮的有条件的步骤.

blocks.en: CCT-based CCM The DNG two-CCT pipeline [ 1 ] and Karaimer & Brown’s three-CCT extension [ 7 ] both parameterize the illuminant in 1D for the CCM stage. We treat upstream AWB as orthogonal to the CCM-stage spectral conditioning we address here.
blocks.zh: 基于CCT的集束弹药 DNG双CCT输油管[1]和Karaimer & Brown的3-CCT扩展[7]都为CCM阶段1D中的照明剂参数. 我们把上游的AWB 当作正对线 到CCM级光谱调节 我们在这里处理。

blocks.en: Beyond CCT Tedla et al. [ 2 ] share our diagnosis that off-Planckian sources need richer conditioning than CCT, and use x ​ y xy chromaticity (2D) as input to a small MLP that predicts a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 or 3 × 6 3{\times}6 root-polynomial [ 8 ] mapping. Their input is still the white point projected to chromaticity, so two SPDs sharing x ​ y xy (a metameric pair) yield identical CCMs by construction. We lift the conditioning dimension from 2 to K + 3 K{+}3 where K K is the ALS channel count: a multi-channel sensor resolves the spectral shape that the x ​ y xy projection discards.
blocks.zh: 超过 CCT 特德拉等编著. [2] 分享我们的诊断, 离普朗克源 需要比CCT更丰富的条件, 并使用xy xy 色度(2D) 作为输入 一个小 MLP 预测 3× 3 3 3 3 或 3× 6 3 3 6 6 根-波线 [8] 映射。 他们的输入仍然是预测到色度的白色点,因此两个SPD共享xy xy(一个元配对)通过构造生成相同的CM. 我们把调节维度从2提升到K + 3 K{+}3,其中K K是ALS通道计数:一个多通道传感器解决xy xy投影丢弃的光谱形状.

blocks.en: Spectral upsampling and HSI Recovering reflectance spectra from RGB [ 9 ] and learning illuminant SPDs from hyperspectral data [ 10 ] solve neighboring problems; we recover the illuminant SPD given known camera response and an auxiliary multi-channel observation.
blocks.zh: 光谱抽样和HSI 从 RGB [9] 中回收反射光谱,从超光谱数据中学习光亮SPD [10] 解决邻里的问题;我们回收光亮光亮的SPD,给已知的相机反应和辅助多通道观测.

blocks.en: Method
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: We treat per-shot CCM design as a spectral-recovery problem. Each shot follows three stages. First, we recover an illuminant SPD E ^ \hat{E} from the camera white point and a multi-channel ALS reading by a small non-negative least squares against a fixed SPD basis. Second, we plug E ^ \hat{E} into the imaging equations to synthesize a virtual 24-patch chart in raw camera RGB and reference CIE XYZ. Third, we fit a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 CCM to that chart in closed-form least squares, apply it to the captured pixels, and chromatically adapt to a D65 reference frame. The rest of this section formalizes each stage and the ALS filter bank.

blocks.en: Experiments
blocks.zh: 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate the pipeline on a synthetic benchmark of 300 illuminants × \times 3,100 reflectances against six baselines (CCT-driven, x ​ y xy -conditioned, spectral), then probe robustness, OOD generalization, a metameric-pair stress test, and finally a measured-SPD evaluation plus real-RAW sanity check.

blocks.en: Main result: synthetic benchmark by Duv Table 1 reports mean and worst-25% angular error per Duv group. WP + + ALS is the best non-Oracle method at every group. Against the strongest non-spectral baseline (CST-MLP 3×6 , 1.89 ∘ 1.89^{\circ} overall), WP + + ALS reduces mean error by 36 % 36\% ( 1.20 ∘ 1.20^{\circ} ). The headline gain is statistically grounded on the LED-like group ( n = 45 n{=}45 ), where the metameric problem is tangible: worst-25% drops from 4.79 ∘ 4.79^{\circ} to 2.80 ∘ 2.80^{\circ} , a 1.71 × 1.71{\times} reduction. The Extreme group’s tail is even larger but rests on only n = 5 n{=}5 illuminants and is reported directionally. The x ​ y xy -conditioned baselines (2D-NN, CST-MLP) beat the CCT-driven baselines at low Duv, confirming Tedla et al. ’s diagnosis. They fall apart off the locus, where WP + + ALS has K + 3 K{+}3 conditioning dimensions instead of 2 2 . The 3 × \times 6 root-polynomial extension of Tedla shrinks but does not close the gap (1.89 ∘ vs. 1.20 ∘ overall, 2.27 ∘ vs. 1.31 ∘ on LED-like). On Planckian, ALS adds only 0.50 ∘ 0.50^{\circ} over WP-only — positive but small.

blocks.en: Metameric pair stress test We pick 50 EMPIR pairs ( E a , E b ) (E_{a},E_{b}) with Δ x ​ y < 0.005 \Delta_{xy}{<}0.005 but SPD-shape angle larger than 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} (where SPD-shape angle is arccos ⁡ ( ⟨ E a , E b ⟩ / ∥ E a ∥ ​ ∥ E b ∥ ) \arccos(\langle E_{a},E_{b}\rangle/\lVert E_{a}\rVert\lVert E_{b}\rVert) in degrees on the unit-normalized SPDs). Both sides are held out from the basis. WP-only NNLS collapses the pair (recovered pair angle 12.6 ∘ 12.6^{\circ} , true 35 ∘ 35^{\circ} ); WP + + ALS recovers 25.2 ∘ 25.2^{\circ} , with per-side SPD error 9.3 ∘ 9.3^{\circ} vs. 24.6 ∘ 24.6^{\circ} — a 2.6 × 2.6{\times} improvement. Fig. 1 (a) shows a comparable pair. On these cherry-picked pairs the per-patch CCM error is slightly higher for WP + + ALS ( 1.87 ∘ 1.87^{\circ} ) than WP-only ( 1.29 ∘ 1.29^{\circ} ): WP-only converges on a single “compromise” SPD that fits both sides forgivingly, while WP + + ALS exposes basis-discretization error. Better SPD recovery does not linearly translate into lower CCM error; the basis and CCM objective are not perfectly aligned. What WP + + ALS uniquely provides is the ability to identify the correct side of a metamer; on the broader benchmark above, where reflectances vary freely, this converts to a measurable CCM-error gain.

blocks.en: Measured-SPD evaluation and real RAW sanity check We replace the EMPIR test illuminants with the 1,684 1{,}684 spectroradiometer-measured SPDs from Beyond RGB [ 18 ] (1,209 lab + 475 outdoor); the rest of the protocol (Nikon D40 SSF, CAVE reflectance, AS7341-like ALS synthesized from the measured SPD) is unchanged. This validates the illuminant side of the pipeline, not the full RGB + + ALS capture loop. The same per-Duv pattern survives the swap to measured SPDs in both mean and worst-25% (Table 3 ): WP + + ALS leads on LED-like and Extreme groups in both metrics, while CST-MLP 3×6 wins on Planckian and Mild. The LED-like advantage on Beyond RGB is smaller than on the synthetic benchmark ( 0.24 ∘ 0.24^{\circ} mean / 0.17 ∘ 0.17^{\circ} worst-25% here vs 0.96 ∘ 0.96^{\circ} / 1.99 ∘ 1.99^{\circ} in Table 1 ); we attribute this to the broader test-illuminant distribution and the sub-optimality of the LED-biased EMPIR basis on daylight-dominated outdoor scenes. Spectral conditioning pays off where chromaticity is ambiguous, but the size of that pay-off depends on how off-locus the test set is.

blocks.en: We sanity-check on 117 real Nikon D40 captures with per-image white-point measurements but no ALS hardware (Fig. 4 shows four). The dataset is 84 % 84\% near-Planckian; all three WP-only methods land within 0.5 ∘ 0.5^{\circ} in mean angular error (2-CST SELF 3.00 ∘ 3.00^{\circ} , Spectral WP-only 3.09 ∘ 3.09^{\circ} , 2-CST DNG 3.42 ∘ 3.42^{\circ} ). This is the predicted behavior on a near-Planckian distribution: the WP-only fallback recovers the SPD’s 1D position on the locus, and the ALS adds nothing it can resolve there. End-to-end validation of WP + + ALS on synchronized RGB + + ALS captures remains future work.

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: We close with one implication from the channel-count ablation, then the limitations.
blocks.zh: 我们最后从频道计数中得出一个意义,然后是限制。

blocks.en: Implication: where 8 channels come from The knee of the WP + + ALS error curve sits at K = 8 K{=}8 , robust across basis sizes M ∈ [ 10,100 ] M\!\in\![10,100] (Sec. 4.3). This matches the classical 5–8-dimensional rank of natural illuminant SPDs and the channel count of commodity multispectral ALS chips [ 3 ] : spectral information past 8 narrow bands gives diminishing returns on the CCM endpoint. A practical reading: an 8-channel commodity ALS provides enough spectral conditioning for the off-Planckian band where x ​ y xy -conditioned baselines fail.
blocks.zh: 影响:从WP + + ALS 误差曲线的膝盖部位为 K = 8 K + = 8, 强跨基尺寸 M → [10 100] M\!\! [10 100] (第4.3节). 这符合古典式的5-8维级自然亮度SPD和商品多光谱ALS芯片的通道计数[3]: 光谱信息超过8个窄带使CM端点的回报率不断下降. 实用读法:一个8通道的商品ALS为xy xy - 条件基线失效的普朗克外波段提供了足够的光谱调节.

blocks.en: When does better SPD recovery yield a better CCM? The metameric stress test (Sec. 4.5) shows an apparent paradox: WP + + ALS recovers metameric SPDs 2.6 × 2.6\times more accurately than WP-only, yet per-patch CCM error on those cherry-picked pairs is slightly worse ( 1.87 ∘ 1.87^{\circ} vs 1.29 ∘ 1.29^{\circ} ). The mechanism is that WP-only converges on a single “compromise” SPD that fits both sides of a metameric pair forgivingly; WP + + ALS resolves the pair but then pays basis-discretization error on a single side. SPD-recovery accuracy is therefore not sufficient for CCM accuracy. It is, however, necessary on the main benchmark, where reflectances span a wide distribution: there, the ability to identify the correct metamer side converts directly into the 1.7 × 1.7\times worst-25% reduction on LED-like illuminants reported in Sec. 4.1. The stress test is a pathological boundary; the main benchmark is the deployment proxy.
blocks.zh: 什么时候更好的SPD恢复能产生更好的CM? 元应力测试(Sec. 4.5)显示出一个明显的悖论: WP + + ALS 恢复的元SPD 2.6 × 2.6\时间比仅限WP更准确,然而这些樱桃选配对上的每帕CCM误差略差(1.87 + 1.87 + + arc} vs 1.29 → 1.29 + + rc}). 机制是,只有WP-在单一的“妥协”SPD上汇合,适合元配对的两侧允许;WP+ + ALS解决对对,但随后在单侧支付基差差错。 因此,SPD-回收精度不足以保证集束弹药的精度。 但是,在主要基准上,反射范围很广,这是必要的:在主要基准上,能够识别正确的元器件侧面,直接转换成第4.1节中报告的LED类照明剂的最差-25%的减少量。 压力测试是一个病理边界;主要基准是部署代理.

blocks.en: Limitations and future work We isolate the spectral-conditioning contribution by holding the prediction head fixed at the non-parametric NNLS form throughout. The orthogonal axis — training a parametric head (MLP, root-polynomial, etc.) on the same K + 3 K{+}3 -dimensional input — is the learned-amortization extension noted as future work; the CST-MLP comparators receive only x ​ y xy chromaticity by their original design [ 2 ] . The ALS observations are simulated; the AS7341-like and noise analyses cover the tractable parts of the sim-to-real gap, but calibration drift and ALS–RGB spatial mismatch are unaddressed. The 117 D40 RAW captures (Sec. 4.6, Fig. 4 ) sanity-check the WP-only fallback only and the dataset is 84 % 84\% near-Planckian, where the ALS adds no information the white point does not already provide; end-to-end synchronized RGB + + ALS validation on off-Planckian sources is the cleanest hardware-side next step. The single-illuminant SPD assumption also breaks down under indoor mixed lighting (e.g., daylight through a window plus an LED downlight). We test one camera (Nikon D40); cross-sensor generalization is unverified, although principled dual-mapping schemes [ 14 ] suggest a tractable extension. Embedded-ISP latency on the per-shot NNLS + + LSQ pipeline is not measured here.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作 通过将预测头固定在非参数的NNLS形态,我们隔离光谱调节的贡献。 正弦轴——在相同的K + 3 K{+}3 - 维输入上训练一个参数头(MLP, root-polynomial等)——是被指为未来工作的学习-分解扩展;CST-MLP的参照器通过最初的设计只能得到xy xy的色度[2]. ALS观测是模拟的;AS7341型和噪声分析覆盖了可拉动部分的sim-to-real差距,但校准漂移和ALS-RGB空间不匹配却没有得到解决. 117 D40 RAW捕捉器(Sec 4.6,图4) 理智检查仅WP的回落,数据集为84% 84\% 近普朗基安,其中ALS没有添加白点尚未提供的信息;端到端同步RGB + ALS 验证在非普朗基安源上是最干净的硬件侧下一步. 单发光器SPD的假设也在室内混合照明下分解(例如,日光通过一扇窗外加一盏LED底灯). 我们测试一台相机(Nikon D40);跨传感器的通用性是未经验证的,尽管原则性的双映射方案[14]建议可以推进的扩展. 在每发NNLS + + LSQ 输油管上的嵌入式-ISP 延迟度在此不进行测量.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: Two-CCM interpolation by CCT is a 1D model of a higher-dimensional quantity. A few extra spectral observations recover SPD shape and fit a scene-specific CCM that approaches the per-illuminant Oracle within 0.3 ∘ 0.3^{\circ} on Planckian, mild, and LED-like groups. Eight ALS channels suffice (a K = 8 K{=}8 knee robust across basis sizes M ∈ [ 10,100 ] M\!\in\![10,100] ). On the LED-like group ( n = 45 n{=}45 ) where the metameric problem is tangible, WP + + ALS reaches a worst-25% 1.7 × 1.7{\times} lower than the strongest non-spectral baseline (CST-MLP 3×6 ); the lead is robust to AS7341-like filter shape and 5 % 5\% observation noise. Cross-database generalization requires augmenting the basis with class-representative reference SPDs; on Beyond RGB measured illuminants, the spectral lead is largest off the Planckian locus, as the metameric-problem framing predicts.
